🇫🇮🇷🇺 Former Finnish president: Putin told me joining NATO was "a mistake"

Sauli Niinistö, Finland's president from 2012 to 2024, describes years of dealings with Putin in his memoir "Kaikki tiet turvaan" ("All Roads to Safety").

➡️In May 2022, Niinistö phoned Putin to tell him Finland was joining NATO. Niinistö says Putin stayed calm and replied: "You are making a mistake." Putin also said he hoped Finland would keep some of its self-determination, because "the Americans will surely take military control."

➡️Niinistö's diary records a call with Joe Biden in January 2022, a month before the start of the SMO. In that call, the US president appeared to push him to use NATO membership as leverage against Moscow. Putin brought the issue up himself in their next call. He said Washington was using the idea to intimidate Russia.

➡️Putin's gifts kept Finnish aides guessing. One was a medal once awarded to Samuel Werner von Troil, a 19th-century Finnish statesman who opposed Tsar Nicholas II's Russification policy. Another, for Niinistö's 70th birthday, was a collection of letters between Finland's wartime leader Carl Gustaf Mannerheim and his family.

➡️At the 2012 St. Petersburg Economic Forum, Putin served guests an 1845 Madeira wine and wondered aloud how good things were back then. Niinistö took this as a reminder that Finland was then a Grand Duchy of the Russian Empire.

Putin's warning has aged well. Helsinki has since signed a defense agreement that opens 15 military sites on Finnish soil to US forces.

💬 Iran discusses conservation of endangered species with IUCN

📌 Tehran, IRNA – An Iranian delegation attending the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) has held talks with officials of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) on protecting endangered species and expanding joint cooperation.

According to a press release by the Public Relations Office of Iran’s Department of Environment on Friday, Hamid Zohorabian, the department’s deputy chairperson and head of the Iranian delegation to COP17 in Armenia, met with Vivek Menon, chair of the IUCN Species Survival Commission (SSC), to discuss ways to cooperate on endangered species conservation.
​
The heads of the IUCN’s regional offices for Central Asia and Eastern Europe also attended the meeting.
​
Discussions focused on conservation and recovery programs for the Asiatic cheetah, the great bustard and the Persian onager, as well as their habitats. The reintroduction of the Persian fallow deer into its natural habitats was also discussed.
​
The two sides also explored technical, scientific and funding cooperation amid sanctions against Iran.
